'''Ryan Hase Imperial Battle Order''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Ryan Hase]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds83.htm Imperial Battle Order], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001029074637/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds83.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
